final: WITH fee_groups AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(feerate) AS avg_fee, AVG(rebrate) AS avg_rebate FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), scope_groups AS (SELECT u.acctscope, AVG(f.avg_fee - f.avg_rebate) AS avg_difference, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM fee_groups AS f JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault COLLATE BINARY = f.orderslink COLLATE BINARY JOIN users AS u ON u.userstamp COLLATE BINARY = o.userlink COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY u.acctscope), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_difference) AS overall_avg FROM scope_groups) SELECT s.acctscope, s.avg_difference, s.record_count, s.avg_difference - v.overall_avg FROM scope_groups AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS v WHERE v.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
